owners: WP10 for the composed authority regression test

rejectedIntake.dependencyClosure: The two published files have no new imports requiring a third source. The exported interface is unchanged. The blocker is a lifecycle regression, not a missing dependency.

finding: The proposed case-port moves its final asynchronous host revalidation before the second asynchronous C08 read. It checks the case/reference digests and Request.signal after that read, but never checks that the same UI/native lease is still live. C08's production authorizer reauthenticates the Request principal and namespace, not that lease. A lease can finish, expire, or be revoked while C08 authorization awaits, with the Request still un-aborted and principal/case bytes unchanged. The proposed port then returns an AuthorizedCaseProjection after its lease has ceased to authorize the call.
staticInterleaving: Admit and consume a real UI or native call. Preserve the same authenticated Request, principal, policy, access revision and case contents throughout.
The first C08 read, both case/evidence/operation verification passes, and the last host.revalidate return successfully.

The proposed port starts its second C08 read. The real state provider awaits input.authorize before and after its read callback; the production authorizer awaits principal resolution against the installation authenticator.

While either of those awaits is outstanding, finish the UI admission, or finish/revoke the native lease/binding, or invalidate its native provider generation. Expiry during this interval is another possible trigger.

These registry changes do not abort the retained Request or change the principal's grants/accessRevision. The production C08 authorizer can still return the same SfStateAuthority; C08 returns the unchanged case successfully.

The proposed port sees equal complete-case/reference digests and source.signal.aborted === false. Without a final registry lookup it returns status ok with a projection. Its previous final host.revalidate, placed after that read in blob 67203e0, would reject this particular interleaving.
whyPublishedTestsDoNotDiscriminate: The two published tests mutate membership/version or same-version case contents during the final host revalidation. They correctly distinguish the old case-snapshot race and must be retained.

Their fixture injects await ui.revalidate(context) into createSfProductState.authorize. The production composition's state authorizer does not call UI/native registries. A lease-ending race during the last read would therefore be suppressed by the fixture's stronger authorization, concealing the production regression.

proposedDelta.description: Retain context kind, binding identity/value and lease identity before the first await. After the second C08 read and existing digest/abort checks, synchronously require host.requestFor(context) === the originally retained Request and unchanged retained context pins. Keep the new final complete-case observation and do not reintroduce an asynchronous gap after it.
proposedDelta.boundedRationale: For the pinned real UI/native registries, requestFor synchronously checks consumed/live admission, expiry, abort, lease finish, binding revocation and invalid provider generation as applicable. Thus the proposed lookup closes the documented registry-lifecycle window without another C08 read or any interface change. The current real context/binding objects are frozen; identity/value pins additionally make the retained admission explicit.
proposedDelta.notClaimed: This lookup is not a substitute for the existing asynchronous authorization, source verification, C08 authority checks or a complete proof of all external source races. Retaining Request identity does not freeze its headers. Hosted counterexamples against the production authority composition are required before accepting a replacement owner publication.

requiredOwnerChecks: Retain both published case-mutation counterexamples and the positive unchanged-case read.

Exercise lease finish during the second C08 authorization with the real product-authority composition, or an explicitly equivalent state authorizer that checks Request/principal/namespace and does not add UI revalidation. Assert the lease did end, the Request remains un-aborted, the case/principal are unchanged, and no projection/value escapes.

Cover UI expiry and native finish/revoke/provider-generation invalidation at the same boundary using the actual registries; assert their requestFor returns undefined and that the final port result is not ok.

Keep exactly two case observations and preserve membership, source coverage, evidence, operation and complete-case digest guards. Verify no additional asynchronous callback occurs after the final registry/identity fence.
consumerScope: WP12 input producers and verifiers consume business.cases.read. This finding is at the C09 port boundary; it does not claim that every outer HTTP/native consumer lacks its own additional egress validation or that a network disclosure was observed.
